description:
Prepare for a professional board meeting by configuring your identity and device settings BEFORE joining. 

Goal: On the Pre-Join (Waiting Room) screen for the meeting 'BoardMeetingQ4':
1. Open Settings > Profile and set Display Name to 'Director Alice' and Email to 'alice@corp.example.com'.
2. Mute your Microphone (ensure the icon is red/slashed).
3. Keep your Camera enabled.
4. Join the meeting.

The meeting URL is http://localhost:8080/BoardMeetingQ4.
